newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Malaysian rubber market is closed today for the Christmas holidays. The market reopens on December 26.
On Tuesday, the rubber market closed at half-day ahead of the Christmas holiday, with prices ending lower in nil trading, dealers said.

At the close, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board (MRELB) quoted market indicator price for January RSS1 buyer at 316.50 cents ($1.25) a kg, down half cent from Monday. January SMR 20 buyer also ended half cent lower at 309 cents.
